_meta.purpose: Civil-society organisations a situation room can be set up for, listed ONLY so the New room picker can identify them. Being listed is NOT verification, partnership or endorsement: every room — listed or typed under Other — waits for Hawkeye's owner to approve it, and at most one room per organisation per race and area is approved (backend/src/services/roomLabels.js).
_meta.seeded: 2026-09-30, from Hawkeye's own outreach materials only: docs/private/outreach/inec-observers-top40.md and inec-accredited-observers.csv (INEC accreditation lists 2024-2026), and 01-eie-nigeria.md. Well-known Nigerian election CSOs; add more here, same shape.
_meta.fields: id: stable key stored on the room (never reuse or rename one). name: shown in the picker. badge: the initials drawn when there is no logo. short: also accepted when someone types the organisation under Other. match: words that, in a ROOM NAME, name this organisation — an all-capitals term matches as a whole word in capitals only; anything else matches as a whole phrase in any case. Never put a generic phrase here ("Situation Room" is the product's own name for every room). site: the organisation's official website, where a logo would come from.
_meta.logos: logo is null for every entry: fetching the files from the official sites waits for the owner's go-ahead. The picker draws the badge instead. When a logo is added, store a small optimised copy as cso/<id>.png (150x150, like logos/ for parties) and record the exact source URL in cso/sources.json.
